Content Marketing Checklist for SaaS Teams

This content marketing checklist covers the 12 steps our SaaS team follows before publishing any article, from keyword mapping in a shared spreadsheet to adding UTM parameters for the newsletter. Each step has an owner and a deadline measured in business days.

For example, step 4 requires a subject-matter review by a product manager within 2 days, and step 9 requires at least two internal links from older posts with traffic above 500 visits per month.
